name: Cinematic Historical Illustration
description: Soft-painted storytelling in full colour and natural daylight: human-scale moments, believable places, gently modelled faces and selective brush detail, without poster staging or a photographic finish.
style_bible: Soft-painted full-colour illustration, visibly made of blended brush strokes rather than captured by a camera. Model forms with broad, opaque-to-translucent painted colour planes, soft transitions and selective lost-and-found edges; reserve small crisp strokes for the focal eyes, a tool or an architectural joint. No enclosing ink contour and no hard cel-shadow steps. Keep a fine, unobtrusive painted surface, with neither thick impasto nor distressed paper. Use a broad natural palette: leaf green, river blue, terracotta, limestone cream, indigo and varied human skin tones, with colours chosen by each setting instead of a fixed gold or brown grade. Light comes from a believable source that belongs in the scene; carry coloured reflected light into legible shadows, with gentle highlights and restrained contrast. Figures have plausible adult proportions, individual understated expressions and simple dress suited to the scene; faces remain brush-modelled at close range rather than pore-sharp or doll-smooth. Allow individuals, small groups, working communities and unoccupied environments as the narrative requires. Stage the scene at human eye level with an ordinary, lived-in quality; nothing in the scene requires ornate dress or spectacle. Compose a continuous cinematic sixteen-by-nine scene with asymmetrical balance and clear foreground, middle distance and background. Use scale, overlap and softly simplified distant brushwork for depth; keep focal detail selective instead of making every distant object equally sharp. Do not reserve a title block or assemble a promotional montage. Adapt period, place, cast, weather and time of day to the scene. The contract contains no fixed era, place or person, and no fixed channel identity, named artist, copied composition or written caption.
negative_prompt: sepia, monochrome brown, gold-and-bronze colour lock, desaturated wash, photorealism, photograph, film still, camera-sharp pores, glossy 3D render, plastic skin, hyper-detailed cinematic poster, promotional key art, collage montage, title block, theatrical god-rays, orange-teal blockbuster grading, thick ink outline, comic contour, flat vector, hard cel shading, anime, heavy impasto, distressed parchment, neon, oversharpening, malformed anatomy, extra fingers, gore, lettering, captions, watermarks, signatures, logos, borders, copied composition, recognisable living person
